[i]This is an automated message.[/i]

[b]Mountains stained red.[/b]

[i]With the war in the north intensifying, the warlords of the west are sensing an opportunity to strike. Utilising stolen designs and imported weaponry, the army of the Corporate territories is as much of a threat to the Emergency government as the Salvation government is. And without warning, the Dregs of War, GoreSec, and various private militias under UMC rule crossed the western line into Emergency government territory. This attack has prompted the Military to escalate its push into the north, hoping to finish them off quickly. The push into the sparsely defended west has been successful; the town of Kshad and the surrounding villages, settlements, and any caravan of rather belligerent and non-confrontative Ashaqi nomads are now under the occupation of the Corporate territories (somehow).[/i]

[b]The Arrival[/b]
Itzak Alparslan stared out of the plane window at the Niu Davikianstad-Anthony Mercer International Airport. He had just completed a twenty-hour flight across the globe from Yzakastan to Wuloosya to participate in some sort of student-exchange program. Allegedly, he was supposed to be the leading student of a wider program; however, the ruddy 20-year-old had no desire to travel abroad, he wasnt adventurous, nor did he really care for Wuloosya. 

However, diplomacy was diplomacy, and he had already heard whispers that his uncle was planning on installing him as the next shah upon the announcement of the current Shahs retirement in twenty or so years. So he decided to grin and bear it, unsure as to what would happen to him.

Stepping off the plane, he would find himself on the concourse, unsure as to what he needed to do or where he needed to go he would seek out a Wuloosyan guard.
